screen: Shared media grid + full-screen media viewer (src/TGMediaViewController.m)

findings.ours: Viewer chrome is two flat CG rectangles: _topBar 44pt tall at y=0 with colorWithWhite:0 alpha:0.6, _bottomBar 60pt tall, and the status bar is hidden on appear (src/TGMediaViewController.m:657-658, 687-690, 766).
findings.theirs: Top and bottom chrome are shipped PNGs: GalleryTopPanel.png placed at y = status bar height (20) so the status bar stays visible, plus a stretched NavigationBar_Corners.png at y=-20; the bottom is a horizontally stretched GalleryBottomPanel.png whose height comes from the art. Status bar is faded via TGHacks setApplicationStatusBarAlpha, never hidden.
findings.fix: Replace the two UIViews with UIImageViews using GalleryTopPanel.png (frame 0,20,width,image.height), NavigationBar_Corners.png stretched at y=-20 inside it, and GalleryBottomPanel.png stretched with leftCapWidth = width/2 pinned to the bottom. Stop calling setStatusBarHidden:YES; fade the status bar alpha instead. The PNGs are not yet in images/ and must be pulled from the original resource set.

findings.ours: _counterLabel uses boldSystemFontOfSize:15 in a 20pt box at y=3, x=70, width-140 (src/TGMediaViewController.m:671-676); a second _dateLabel systemFontOfSize:11 sits under it at y=22 in the top bar.
findings.theirs: Counter label is boldSystemFontOfSize:20, frame (floorf((width-140)/2), 11, 140, 20), white with a 0x000000/0.5 shadow offset (0,-1). There is no date in the top panel at all — date lives in the bottom panel.
findings.fix: Set _counterLabel.font = boldSystemFontOfSize:20, frame ((width-140)/2, 11, 140, 20), shadowColor UIColorRGBA(0x000000,0.5), shadowOffset (0,-1); remove _dateLabel from the top bar and move the date to the bottom panel (see the bottom-panel finding).

findings.ours: Bottom bar carries a text button "Actions" at (4,10,66,40), a 3-line caption label systemFontOfSize:13 at (74,0,width-164,60), and a text "Play"/"▶ m:ss" button at the right (src/TGMediaViewController.m:693-717, 1071).
findings.theirs: Bottom panel is: an image action button GalleryActionIcon.png at (6,2,40,40) on the left; a trash button GalleryTrashIcon.png at (width-40-6, 2, 40, 40) on the right; a centred author label boldSystemFontOfSize:14 at ((width-220)/2, 4, 220, 20); a centred date label at ((width-140)/2, 23, 140, 20) with dateFont 13 / dateLabelFont 11; and a centred VideoPanelPlay.png / VideoPanelPause.png image button that replaces author+date while a video is playable. No caption text is shown anywhere.
findings.fix: Rebuild the bottom bar to that layout: icon buttons at both ends, centred author (bold 14, y=4) over centred date (13, y=23) both white with 0x000000/0.5 shadow at (0,-1), and a centred play/pause image button that toggles author/date alpha to 0 when visible. Drop the caption label; expose delete as the right-hand trash button instead of an action-sheet row.

findings.theirs: A TGToolbarButton on the LEFT of the top panel, text TGLocalized(@"Common.Close") = "Close", built from stretched GalleryDoneButton.png / GalleryDoneButton_Highlighted.png (leftCapWidth 11), minWidth 55, touchInset (16,16), sizeToFit then offset by (5, 7).
findings.fix: Move the button to the left edge at offset (5,7), size to fit with minWidth 55, title "Close", and back it with the stretched GalleryDoneButton.png artwork rather than a bare title.

findings.ours: self.title = @"Shared Media", overridden by chatTitle in viewDidLoad (src/TGMediaViewController.m:1469, 1654-1655).
findings.theirs: self.titleText = NSLocalizedString(@"ConversationMedia.Title", nil), which is "Media". The chat title is never put in this navigation bar.
findings.fix: Set the title to "Media" and delete the chatTitle override in viewDidLoad.

findings.ours: Empty state is a single UILabel, systemFontOfSize:15, secondaryTextColour, text "No shared media" / "No shared files" / "No shared links" / "No shared music", positioned at height/2 - 50 (src/TGMediaViewController.m:151-158, 1555-1565).
findings.theirs: Empty state is a PhotosBlankPlaceholder.png image with a label 12pt below it, boldSystemFontOfSize:17, colour UIColorRGB(0x808895) on white, text TGLocalized(@"ConversationMedia.Empty") = "No Photos in this Conversation"; the whole group is centred in the view and inserted BELOW the table, fading in over the standard animation when !canLoadMore && count == 0.
findings.fix: For the Media scope use the image+label group: PhotosBlankPlaceholder.png, gap 12, label boldSystemFontOfSize:17 in #808895, text "No Photos in this Conversation", container centred in self.view and inserted belowSubview:_tableView, alpha faded in. Keep the invented Files/Links/Music strings but match the 17pt bold #808895 type.

findings.ours: Each tile is a bare TGRemoteImageView with a flat 0.87-white CG-generated placeholder and no shadow (src/TGMediaViewController.m:53-65, 293-304).
findings.theirs: Each 75x75 tile gets a shadow UIImageView built from [TGInterfaceAssets mediaGridImageShadow] (MediaGridImageShadow.png, stretched in centre) added as a subview of the image view, and the placeholder is the shipped FlatImagePlaceholder.png via mediaGridImagePlaceholder.
findings.fix: Add a stretched MediaGridImageShadow.png UIImageView per tile and use FlatImagePlaceholder.png as the placeholder instead of TGMediaTilePlaceholder()'s CG grey. Neither PNG is in images/ yet; both need to be added. docs/design-language/typography-colour.md:300 already states the shadow is artwork, so our code contradicts the rulebook.

findings.ours: TGMediaPageGap = 20; the paging scroll view sits at x=0 with width = bounds.width + 20 and each page is laid out full-bounds-width (src/TGMediaViewController.m:22, 644-645, 805, 815-816).
findings.theirs: pageGap = 40. The paging scroll view is placed at x = -pageGap/2 with width = bounds.width + pageGap, and each page frame is (index * width + pageGap/2, 0, width - pageGap, height) so the gap is split evenly on both sides of every page.
findings.fix: Set TGMediaPageGap = 40, position _pagingView at x = -20 with width bounds.width + 40, and lay each page out at (index * pageWidth + 20, 0, bounds.width - 40, height).

findings.ours: While the full image downloads we spin a white large UIActivityIndicatorView in the centre of the screen, and on failure show an invented rounded "Tap to retry" button (src/TGMediaViewController.m:719-739, 1004-1031).
findings.theirs: Download progress is shown in the bottom panel: the controls container fades to 0 and a progress container fades in carrying the author name plus a systemFontOfSize:13 white label reading TGLocalized(@"Preview.LoadingImage") = "loading full image..." (or "loading video..."), with a 15x15 TGClockProgressView pinned at x = -19 to the left of that label. There is no centre spinner and no retry affordance.
findings.fix: Move the loading indication into the bottom bar as a 13pt white label "loading full image..." / "loading video..." with a small clock progress view 19pt to its left, cross-fading with the author/date container; remove the centre white spinner and the "Tap to retry" button.

findings.ours: Action sheet is default-styled and offers "Save Image" / "Save Video", "Forward", "Delete" (src/TGMediaViewController.m:1218-1234).
findings.theirs: The sheet is UIActionSheetStyleBlackTranslucent; the action button's sheet only offers TGLocalized(@"Preview.SaveToCameraRoll") = "Save to Camera Roll" plus Common.Cancel, and deletion is a separate confirmation sheet whose destructive title is Preview.DeletePhoto = "Delete Photo" or Preview.DeleteVideo = "Delete Video", raised by the trash button.
findings.fix: Set actionSheetStyle = UIActionSheetStyleBlackTranslucent, rename the save row to "Save to Camera Roll" for both photo and video, and move deletion out of this sheet into a trash-button-triggered sheet titled "Delete Photo"/"Delete Video".

findings.ours: Grid screen background and table background use [[TGTheme shared] listBackgroundColour] (src/TGMediaViewController.m:1470, 1481).
findings.theirs: self.view.backgroundColor = [UIColor whiteColor] for the shared-media grid.
findings.fix: Use plain white for the grid screen's view and table background (the list scopes may keep the themed list colour, but the Media grid was white).

findings.ours: The video badge play glyph is CG-drawn via [TGIcons play] and vertically centred inside the 19pt bar with MIN(11,...) clamping (src/TGMediaViewController.m:315-319, TGIcons.m:210).
findings.theirs: The badge icon is the shipped MessageInlineVideoIcon.png, added at a fixed offset of (4, 5) from the bar's origin, in a bar of exactly (0, 75-19, 75, 19) with colour UIColorRGBA(0x000000, 0.6f) and a right-aligned boldSystemFontOfSize:10 label at (75-56-3, 0, 56, 19).
findings.fix: Use MessageInlineVideoIcon.png at its natural size offset by (4,5) instead of the CG play glyph. Bar geometry, 0.6 black, and the 10pt bold right-aligned 56x19 label already match.

findings.ours: The loading row's spinner is centred vertically in the 50pt row at y=25 (src/TGMediaViewController.m:1844).
findings.theirs: The loading cell's gray activity indicator is horizontally centred but pinned at y = 14 in the 50pt row, not centred.
findings.fix: Position the loading spinner with frame origin y = 14 rather than centering it at y = 25.

findings.ours: The grid table has no bottom content inset (src/TGMediaViewController.m:1477-1485).
findings.theirs: The controller sets an explicit table inset of UIEdgeInsetsMake(0, 0, 4, 0) with a zero scroll-indicator inset, so the last row of tiles clears the bottom by 4pt, matching the 4pt gap above each row.
findings.fix: Set _tableView.contentInset bottom to 4 while leaving scrollIndicatorInsets at zero.

findings.ours: Zoom is minimumZoomScale 1.0 / maximumZoomScale 3.0, and double tap zooms to a fixed 2.5x rect (src/TGMediaViewController.m:539-540, 1112).
findings.theirs: Maximum zoom is derived: for a fitted image it is minScale * 2.0f (i.e. exactly 2x the fitted size), otherwise the natural pixel scale; double tap toggles between minimumZoomScale and that maximum, never a hard-coded factor.
findings.fix: Compute maximumZoomScale as minimumZoomScale * 2 (clamped to the image's natural scale) and make double-tap toggle between min and max rather than zooming to a 2.5x rect.

findings.theirs: toggleShowHide uses asymmetric durations: 0.15s to show, 0.3s to hide.
findings.fix: Use 0.15s when revealing the bars and 0.3s when hiding them.

findings.ours: Tapping a tile always opens the full-screen viewer, whatever the tile is showing (src/TGMediaViewController.m:499-511).
findings.theirs: The tap handler bails out when the tile has not finished loading: `UIImage *currentImage = [remoteImageView currentImage]; if (currentImage == nil) return;` — a still-placeholder tile is not tappable.
findings.fix: In -handleTap:, ignore the hit when the matched tile's image is still the placeholder (no loaded image), matching the original's no-op on unloaded tiles.
